title: What If Your Reflexes Were 100x Faster?

shots.line: A wasp drifts toward your sandwich.
shots.scene: garden wide: Theo at picnic table with sandwich, wasp drifts in from right, slow push

shots.line: You watch it come.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo calm, eyes track the blurred wasp across frame

shots.line: Slowly.
shots.scene: TIME SLOW: wasp macro hanging in golden air, wings barely moving, 100x badge

shots.line: Like a feather sinking through honey.
shots.scene: metaphor: a feather sinking through amber honey, bubbles, slow

shots.line: You have time to count its stripes...
shots.scene: wasp close-up, stripes counted 1-2-3-4 with gold tick labels

shots.line: and step aside.
shots.scene: garden medium: Theo leans aside casually, wasp sails past, sandwich in hand

shots.line: Your mom drops a glass.
shots.scene: kitchen wide morning: Mom at counter, glass slips from her hand; Theo at table, Sam beside

shots.line: You see it tip.
shots.scene: insert: glass tipping off fingertips, slow, cool rim

shots.line: You see it fall.
shots.scene: TIME SLOW: glass falling, water drops frozen in air

shots.line: You remember where the dustpan is...
shots.scene: bigFace Theo thinking; thought callout: dustpan in the cupboard (blueprint line art)

shots.line: before it even reaches the floor.
shots.scene: low insert: glass hangs a hand above the floor tiles, Theo's hand already holding the dustpan

shots.line: Your little brother blinks.
shots.scene: medium: Sam at the table, eyelids starting to close

shots.line: To you, that blink takes ten seconds.
shots.scene: bigFace Sam mid-blink; readout NORMAL 0.1 s vs YOU 10 s

shots.line: Theo, why are you staring at me?
shots.scene: OTS: Theo's blurred shoulder fg, Sam half-blinking, talking

shots.line: Because, Sam... your eyelid is still closing.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo deadpan, talking

shots.line: And your toast? It still hasn’t popped.
shots.scene: insert: toaster, glowing coils, bread waiting

shots.line: You’ve been waiting for it for what feels like an hour.
shots.scene: Theo slumped at the toaster, chin on hand, wall clock crawling

shots.line: Your name is Theo. You’re fourteen.
shots.scene: Theo turns to camera in kitchen light; callout THEO, then 14

shots.line: A normal person reacts to something they see in about a quarter of a second.
shots.scene: blueprint: NORMAL HUMAN reaction bar fills to 0.25 s

shots.line: You? Two and a half thousandths.
shots.scene: blueprint: YOU row appears, tiny gold bar 0.0025 s

shots.line: A hundred times faster.
shots.scene: giant gold 100x stamps in with shimmer

shots.line: Drop a ruler between most people’s fingers, and it falls about thirty centimeters before they grab it.
shots.scene: blueprint ruler drop: ruler falls between line-art fingers, dimension 30 cm

shots.line: Drop one for you... and your brain notices after three hundredths of a millimeter.
shots.scene: macro: ruler barely moved, magnifier, dimension 0.03 mm in gold

shots.line: The catch?
shots.scene: bigLine THE CATCH? over dark haze

shots.line: Your brain got a hundred times faster.
shots.scene: blueprint: line-art head, brain glowing gold, 100x

shots.line: Your body did not.
shots.scene: same figure, body stays dull blue, 1x

shots.line: Your nerves still carry signals at about a hundred meters per second.
shots.scene: nerve path brain to arm, a slow pulse crawls along it, ~100 m/s

shots.line: Your legs still run like any fourteen-year-old’s.
shots.scene: track side view: Theo jogs past at ordinary speed

shots.line: You see everything coming...
shots.scene: bigFace Theo, eyes wide, sees everything

shots.line: you just can’t move any faster to meet it.
shots.scene: Theo strains forward, ghost afterimages of his mind racing ahead; body lagging

shots.line: So what if your reflexes were a hundred times faster?
shots.scene: TITLE CARD over sunset city: WHAT IF YOUR REFLEXES WERE 100X FASTER?

shots.line: Plus: you never lose at catch.
shots.scene: park wide at golden hour, Theo and Mia with a ball; PLUS badge

shots.line: Your best friend Mia throws a ball at your face.
shots.scene: medium two-shot: Mia winds up and throws the ball at Theo's face

shots.line: You have time to yawn.
shots.scene: TIME SLOW: bigFace Theo yawning, ball frozen inches away, 100x badge

shots.line: Then you catch it.
shots.scene: snap: Theo catches the ball one-handed, shockwave rings

shots.line: How... how did you even see that?
shots.scene: bigFace Mia shocked, talking: How... how did you even see that?

shots.line: I see everything, Mia.
shots.scene: medium: Theo smirks, tossing the ball, talking

shots.line: Okay. That’s actually creepy.
shots.scene: two-shot: Mia steps back, nervous, talking: That's actually creepy

shots.line: Video games?
shots.scene: bedroom at night: Theo in gaming chair lit by monitor

shots.line: You read every enemy before it moves.
shots.scene: screen insert: enemies with prediction arrows drawn before they move

shots.line: Forty wins in a row.
shots.scene: screen: WINS counter races to 40

shots.line: Then the game bans you for cheating.
shots.scene: screen turns red: BANNED - SUSPECTED CHEATING

shots.line: Dude.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo in red monitor light, talking: Dude.

shots.line: Even the computer thinks you’re cheating.
shots.scene: wide: Theo facepalms in his chair, red glow

shots.line: Movies?
shots.scene: cinema: Theo and Mia in a dark row, projector beam

shots.line: A film shows twenty-four pictures every second.
shots.scene: insert: film strip racing past, counter 24 / s

shots.line: Everyone else sees motion.
shots.scene: screen: smooth running horse silhouette, motion blur, Mia smiling

shots.line: You see... a slideshow.
shots.scene: Theo's view: same screen as stepped single frames, black gaps

shots.line: Click. Click. Click.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo blank, screen light snaps on his face on each Click

shots.line: Great movie, right?
shots.scene: two-shot in seats: Mia beams, talking

shots.line: Very... clicky.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo deadpan, talking: Very... clicky.

shots.line: Minus: some old lights flicker a hundred times a second.
shots.scene: MINUS badge; school hallway, fluorescent tubes flickering, 100 Hz label

shots.line: Nobody notices. You do.
shots.scene: students walk normally; Theo squints at the ceiling

shots.line: Your school hallway strobes like a nightclub.
shots.scene: hallway strobing like a nightclub, coloured flashes, figures in stop-motion

shots.line: Then there’s track.
shots.scene: 3D: athletics track at dusk, floodlights, slow crane

shots.line: Coach Lee fires the starting gun.
shots.scene: Coach Lee raises the starting pistol and fires; smoke puff

shots.line: You’re gone before the smoke clears.
shots.scene: Theo explodes out of the blocks, speed trail, smoke still hanging

shots.line: And disqualified.
shots.scene: red DQ stamp slams over Theo, coach blows whistle

shots.line: Leave the blocks less than a tenth of a second after the gun, and the rules decide you must have guessed.
shots.scene: blueprint timeline after the gun: 0 to 0.30 s, red FALSE START zone under 0.10 s

shots.line: The best sprinters react in about fifteen hundredths.
shots.scene: marker BEST SPRINTERS at 0.15 s

shots.line: Nobody beats a tenth.
shots.scene: red wall at 0.10 s

shots.line: Nobody... except you.
shots.scene: gold YOU marker beyond the wall at 0.0025 s

shots.line: So you learn the strangest skill in sport.
shots.scene: Theo in the blocks, Coach standing over him, dusk

shots.line: Waiting.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo eyes closed, breathing, slow tick

shots.line: Coach Lee hands you a rule.
shots.scene: Coach hands Theo a small card

shots.line: Count, Theo.
shots.scene: bigFace Coach Lee talking: Count, Theo.

shots.line: Count to what?
shots.scene: two-shot: Theo confused, talking

shots.line: Count until you’re on time.
shots.scene: two-shot: Coach explains, pointing

shots.line: Fast doesn’t matter. On time does.
shots.scene: bigLine FAST DOESN'T MATTER. / ON TIME DOES. over dusk track

shots.line: But where it gets really crazy... is the road.
shots.scene: night road: Theo on the sidewalk, headlights streaming, rain-slick

shots.line: A car at fifty kilometers per hour moves about fourteen meters every second.
shots.scene: car passes; readout 50 km/h, then dimension 14 m per second

shots.line: You see every one of those meters.
shots.scene: TIME SLOW: car frozen, 14 metre ticks light up one by one

shots.line: You see drivers glance at phones.
shots.scene: insert: driver silhouette lit by a phone screen

shots.line: You see near-misses nobody else even notices.
shots.scene: top-down: car and cyclist paths almost touch, 0.4 m gap

shots.line: And there’s a cost.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo sad, rain light

shots.line: The price?
shots.scene: bigLine THE PRICE? in coral

shots.line: Every second feels like a minute and forty seconds.
shots.scene: clock: 1 SECOND = 1 MIN 40 S, second hand crawling

shots.line: A ten-minute lesson feels like more than sixteen hours.
shots.scene: classroom: teacher at board, Theo slumped, readout 10 MIN = 16+ HOURS

shots.line: Mia says good morning...
shots.scene: hallway morning: Mia waves and starts to talk

shots.line: and you plan your answer, rewrite it twice,
shots.scene: Theo with a thought bubble: drafts written, crossed out twice

shots.line: and get bored waiting for her to finish.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo sleepy while Mia's mouth moves in slow motion behind

shots.line: Your mind lives a hundred days for every day you live.
shots.scene: blueprint calendar: 1 day vs a grid of 100 days filling

shots.line: People start to feel like statues.
shots.scene: TIME SLOW: crowded hallway frozen like grey statues, Theo moves between them

shots.line: Beautiful.
shots.scene: statues in golden window light, dust hanging

shots.line: And lonely. Usually both at once.
shots.scene: pull-out: Theo small and alone among the statues

shots.line: Who talks to statues?
shots.scene: Theo sits on a bench beside a frozen classmate

shots.line: And who... is going to wait for you?
shots.scene: empty corridor, Theo walks away into the light

shots.line: Sam does.
shots.scene: school gate golden afternoon: Sam jumps up waving

shots.line: Your seven-year-old brother.
shots.scene: medium: Sam grinning, yellow cap; label 7

shots.line: The only person who doesn’t think you’re weird.
shots.scene: Sam hugs Theo's leg, Theo smiles

shots.line: He waits for you at the school gate every afternoon.
shots.scene: wide: Sam sitting on the gate wall, swinging legs, waiting

shots.line: He listens to your endless stories.
shots.scene: walking home at sunset, Theo talking, story bubbles; Sam listening, joy

shots.line: He never once says... hurry up.
shots.scene: bigFace Sam smiling up at Theo

shots.line: Years ago, you taught him a game.
shots.scene: flashback (soft, faded): backyard, Theo younger teaching little Sam

shots.line: A whistle.
shots.scene: insert: Theo whistles, musical rings

shots.line: Two notes. High, then low.
shots.scene: two notes on a staff: HIGH then LOW, waveform

shots.line: It means: freeze.
shots.scene: FREEZE in big letters; Sam stops mid-run

shots.line: Whenever you whistle, he stops mid-step like a robot.
shots.scene: Sam frozen mid-step like a robot, Theo laughing

shots.line: Every single time.
shots.scene: triptych: Sam frozen in three different places

shots.line: Even in the supermarket.
shots.scene: supermarket aisle: Sam frozen mid-step, shoppers stare

shots.line: Sam! Not in the cereal aisle!
shots.scene: Theo, embarrassed, talking: Sam! Not in the cereal aisle!

shots.line: Robots don’t choose aisles, Theo.
shots.scene: bigFace Sam deadpan, frozen, talking

shots.line: Sports day.
shots.scene: 3D: stadium on sports day, crowd, flags, main road beside it

shots.line: The hundred-meter final.
shots.scene: finalists line up; giant screen 100 M FINAL

shots.line: The track sits right beside the main road.
shots.scene: wide: track, fence, an open gate, the main road beyond

shots.line: Your whole family is watching.
shots.scene: stands: Mom, Sam and Mia cheering

shots.line: You crouch in the blocks.
shots.scene: Theo crouches into the blocks, side view

shots.line: On your marks.
shots.scene: Coach Lee lifts the pistol, talking

shots.line: Set.
shots.scene: Theo hips up, frozen tension, crowd hushed

shots.line: Your brain waits for the gun.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo determined, heartbeat

shots.line: And then... you see it.
shots.scene: extreme close on Theo's eye, it flicks right

shots.line: A red ball bouncing through the open gate.
shots.scene: red ball bouncing through the open gate toward the road

shots.line: And a small boy chasing it.
shots.scene: Sam runs after the ball

shots.line: Sam.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo shocked

shots.line: Down the road comes a delivery truck.
shots.scene: golden road: delivery truck rolling toward camera

shots.line: Fifty kilometers per hour. Forty meters away. Under three seconds.
shots.scene: truck; readouts 50 km/h, 40 m, 2.9 s countdown

shots.line: You do the math... in a blink.
shots.scene: TIME FREEZE: blueprint math lines over the frozen stadium, Theo blinks

shots.line: You’re sixty meters from that gate.
shots.scene: top-down map: Theo at the blocks, gate 60 m away, truck, Sam

shots.line: Even the fastest man in history needed over six seconds to cover sixty meters.
shots.scene: blueprint: fastest sprinter line-figure, 60 m in 6+ s

shots.line: You’d need eight.
shots.scene: YOU 8 s bar in coral vs truck 2.9 s

shots.line: Your brain is fast. Your legs are not.
shots.scene: brain gold / legs grey

shots.line: You can’t reach him.
shots.scene: frozen wide: Theo far from the gate, Sam near the curb

shots.line: And the gun hasn’t fired.
shots.scene: insert: pistol, finger on trigger, frozen

shots.line: Move now... and you’re out.
shots.scene: Theo in blocks; red DQ ghost flickers over him

shots.line: Months of training. Gone.
shots.scene: memories of training as fading frames, then GONE

shots.line: The race... or your brother.
shots.scene: split: finish line left, Sam right

shots.line: You stand up.
shots.scene: Theo rises out of the blocks

shots.line: Before the gun.
shots.scene: Coach Lee, pistol raised, startled

shots.line: The crowd groans.
shots.scene: crowd slumps, groan

shots.line: False start.
shots.scene: stadium screen flashes FALSE START

shots.line: But you don’t run.
shots.scene: Theo standing still while others stay crouched

shots.line: Running won’t work.
shots.scene: top-down: dotted run path to the gate, crossed out

shots.line: Instead, you whistle.
shots.scene: bigFace Theo whistling, rings

shots.line: Two notes. High, then low.
shots.scene: two gold note rings leave Theo and sweep across the field

shots.line: Sound travels at about three hundred and forty meters per second.
shots.scene: blueprint: sound wave arcs crossing 60 m, 340 m/s

shots.line: It reaches Sam in less than a fifth of a second.
shots.scene: timer: 0.18 s, wave hits Sam's icon

shots.line: You watch the sound arrive.
shots.scene: TIME FREEZE: wide, gold rings crawling across the field toward Sam

shots.line: You watch him hear it.
shots.scene: Sam's head, the ring touches it, eyes widen

shots.line: And Sam... freezes.
shots.scene: Sam stops dead, mid-step

shots.line: One foot in the air. Right at the curb.
shots.scene: low insert: Sam's foot hovering over the curb edge, truck lights growing

shots.line: The truck rushes past.
shots.scene: truck blurs past between camera and Sam, shake

shots.line: The ball rolls under its wheels.
shots.scene: red ball rolls under the giant wheel

shots.line: Pop.
shots.scene: POP: ball bursts, flash and rings

shots.line: Silence.
shots.scene: still wide: empty road, dust settling, Sam frozen at the curb

shots.line: Then Sam turns around... and waves.
shots.scene: Sam turns around and waves

shots.line: The whole stadium saw it.
shots.scene: crowd on its feet, stunned

shots.line: Coach Lee walks over.
shots.scene: Coach Lee walks over to Theo

shots.line: You know you’re disqualified, right?
shots.scene: bigFace Coach smiling, talking

shots.line: I know. Fast doesn’t matter. On time does.
shots.scene: two-shot: Theo smiles, talking; Coach's hand on his shoulder

shots.line: Mia is crying.
shots.scene: bigFace Mia crying happy tears

shots.line: Your mom is running.
shots.scene: Mom runs across the field

shots.line: And Sam crashes into your arms.
shots.scene: Sam leaps into Theo's arms

shots.line: For once, you don’t mind that every second lasts so long.
shots.scene: warm slow push on the hug, sunset, dust

shots.line: You want this one... to last forever.
shots.scene: 3D: slow orbit around the hug in the evening light

shots.line: That night, a letter slides under your door.
shots.scene: bedroom night, moonlight; a letter slides under the door

shots.line: No name. Just one line.
shots.scene: insert: blank envelope in Theo's hands, moonlight

shots.line: ‘We saw what you did on that road.
shots.scene: the letter's single line appears

shots.line: We would like to test you.’
shots.scene: bigFace Theo reading, moonlit, awe

shots.line: Is any of this real?
shots.scene: bigLine IS ANY OF THIS REAL?

shots.line: Partly.
shots.scene: blueprint: PARTLY. stamp

shots.line: Human visual reaction really sits around a quarter of a second.
shots.scene: blueprint: real human reaction bar 0.25 s

shots.line: Sprinting really does treat anything under a tenth of a second as a false start.
shots.scene: blueprint: false-start rule under 0.10 s

shots.line: And some animals really do see faster than us.
shots.scene: blueprint: eyes of animals, fly eye glowing

shots.line: Houseflies notice flicker that looks like smooth light to you,
shots.scene: blueprint: lamp light smooth for human vs strobing for the fly

shots.line: which helps explain why they’re so hard to swat.
shots.scene: kitchen: a hand swats, the fly casually dodges

shots.line: But a human brain a hundred times faster?
shots.scene: brain 100x with a question mark

shots.line: Your nerves are simply too slow to keep up.
shots.scene: nerve pulse crawling, too slow

shots.line: So could anything ever make human reflexes truly instant?
shots.scene: Theo at the moonlit window holding the letter, slow push

shots.line: What do you think? Tell us in the comments, and tell us which superpower we should do next. Hit like, and subscribe for more What Ifs.
shots.scene: END SCREEN: question, comment bubble, subscribe, cast lined up
